problem_text:
A telecommunications firm must establish a dedicated fiber-optic ring connecting 13 regional network hubs.

Due to existing infrastructure conflicts, a direct cable cannot be laid between Hub Alpha and Hub Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to regulatory and right-of-way restrictions, exactly one of the following two cable segments must be incorporated into the ring: the segment between Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the segment between Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total cable length required to form a closed ring that visits each hub exactly once and returns to the starting hub.
